country.match: Match each natural wonder to its country.
country.odd: Three of these natural wonders are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Yellowstone National Park
rows.description: first national park in the world, located in Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho in the United States
rows.hook: was the first of its kind in the world and is famed for its geysers, hot springs and roaming bison

rows.label: Grand Canyon
rows.description: steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States
rows.hook: exposes about two billion years of rock in a mile-deep gorge cut by a mighty river

rows.label: Uluru
rows.description: large sandstone isolated mount in Australia
rows.hook: is a giant red sandstone monolith in the outback, sacred to the Aboriginal people of the area

rows.label: Great Barrier Reef
rows.description: over 2300 km long coral reef off Australia's northeast coast, UNESCO World Heritage Site
rows.hook: is the largest living structure on Earth, so big it can be seen from space

rows.label: Atacama Desert
rows.description: desert in South America
rows.hook: is the driest place on Earth outside the poles, with some weather stations that have never recorded rain

rows.label: Death Valley
rows.description: desert basin in Inyo and San Bernadino counties in California, United States
rows.hook: holds the record for the hottest air temperature ever measured on Earth

rows.label: Giant's Causeway
rows.description: rock formation on the Antrim coast of Northern Ireland
rows.hook: is made of about 40,000 interlocking basalt columns, said in legend to be a path built by an Irish warrior

rows.label: Crater Lake
rows.description: caldera lake in south-central Oregon and main feature of Crater Lake National Park
rows.hook: is the deepest lake in its country, famed for its deep blue water filling a collapsed volcano

rows.label: Devils Tower
rows.description: mountain near Moorcroft, Wyoming, United States
rows.hook: is a towering butte of columnar rock that was the first national monument and starred in a Spielberg film

rows.label: Danakil Depression
rows.description: geological depression, northern part of the Afar Triangle or Afar Depression in Ethiopia

rows.label: Angel Falls
rows.description: waterfall in Venezuela; highest uninterrupted waterfall in the world
rows.hook: is the tallest uninterrupted waterfall in the world, plunging off a flat-topped mountain

rows.label: Bay of Fundy
rows.description: bay on the Atlantic coast of Canada noted for high tides
rows.hook: has the highest tides in the world, rising and falling by about the height of a four-story building

rows.label: Mammoth Cave
rows.description: cave system in Kentucky, United States of America
rows.hook: is the longest known system of underground passages in the world, with hundreds of miles mapped

rows.label: Meteor Crater
rows.description: meteorite impact crater in northern Arizona

rows.label: Salar de Uyuni
rows.description: salt flat in Bolivia

rows.label: Kīlauea
rows.description: active volcano in Hawaii
rows.hook: is among the most active volcanoes on Earth and is home to the legendary fire goddess Pele

rows.label: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park
rows.description: park in Hunan province in China

rows.label: Lençóis Maranhenses National Park
rows.description: national park in northeastern Brazil, known for its rolling dunes and fresh water lagoons

rows.label: Old Faithful
rows.description: geyser in Yellowstone National Park in Wyoming, United States
rows.hook: is a famously predictable geyser that erupts roughly every hour and a half

rows.label: Great Blue Hole
rows.description: submarine sinkhole off the coast of Belize
rows.hook: is a giant circular sinkhole in the sea, seen from above as a deep dark eye in pale shallows

rows.label: Ha Long Bay
rows.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Vietnam
